page.title: Flows
page.purpose: Author, validate, and browse reusable device flows, including the capability gap report that says whether a given device can run one.

priorities.statement: A flow's capability requirements and the resulting gap report are shown before any run can start.
priorities.notes: A pre-execution gap is actionable; a mid-run failure is wasted device time and confusing evidence.

priorities.statement: Each step shows which resolution rung it will use on the selected device.
priorities.notes: The difference between a deterministic and an inferred step is what a reviewer most needs to see.

priorities.statement: Bounded wait policies are shown with their upper bounds.
priorities.notes: A named bound is reviewable; a raw sleep is not.
